_note: The Local Sheet / Local Volume (WS-1, RFC-037) — the galaxy groups within ~10 Mpc of the Local Group, arranged in the flattened Local Sheet. A SCHEMATIC, NOT TO SCALE (PRD-030 principle 2): the Local Group sits at the origin as the 'you are here' anchor, and each neighbouring group is placed in a thin illustrative layout. Distances (dist_mpc) + classifications are real; the xyz layout is hand-authored for legibility (matching the local-group.json precedent). The precise supergalactic-coordinate placement is deferred to the Virgo / Laniakea tiers where the plane's structure carries meaning.
_provenance: Distances + types: NASA/IPAC NED, Karachentsev Local Volume catalogue (2013), Anand et al. TRGB distances (2018–2019), Tully et al. Cosmicflows. Schematic positions hand-authored for legibility. Science-reviewed 2026-08-08 (IC 342 + Maffei split into distinct groups; NGC 6946 → 7.7 Mpc; Sculptor → 3.7 Mpc).
